name: Plutocratic Capture
definition: Influence tracks holdings rather than earned standing, so the largest holders determine outcomes.
trigger_conditions: Weight is a function of balance, stake size, or compute rather than validated performance
Holdings are acquirable on an open market
No cap, curve, or quadratic dampening applies to concentration

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: instrument design changing whose interests a decider serves

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F007 Plutocratic Capture. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F007
